{{Quote|When I was young, I lost my mother, the person who I admired most. Her... Her heart gave out. Had simple organ cloning been available on my homeworld, her death would have been easily preventable.|Penn Pershing|<ref name="Chapter 19" />}}
[[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[scientist]] [[Penn Pershing]] was [[Reproduction|born]] to a '''mother''' on an [[Penn Pershing's homeworld|astronomical object]]. His mother was a [[doctor]] in their hometown.<ref name="Chapter 19" /> While Penn was a young [[Gender|man]],<ref name="Amazon">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> she later [[death|perished]] of [[heart]] failure, due to the planet lacking access on simple organ [[cloning]] technology, prompting Pershing to dedicate his life on the pursuit of perfecting cloning technology and making it available to the entire [[galaxy]]. [[Standard year|Years]] later, Pershing recounted the story of her passing before a crowd in [[Coruscant]]'s [[Galaxies Opera House]] as part of his participation in the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Amnesty Program|Amnesty Program]].<ref name="Chapter 19" />

Her son spent days in her office as a child, dreaming of a high-tech [[laboratory]], a story he would later recount to [[Elia Kane]] while collecting scientific supplies from a retired [[Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Chapter 19" />
